title: Analysis-Ready Los Angeles County Safety-Net Diabetes EHR Dataset for Diabetic Retinopathy Epidemiology
target_analytical_method: Illustrative complete-case modified Poisson regression with robust standard errors for prevalence associations

variables.description: Generated source-record identifier; not an independently verified patient identifier
variables.source_variable: Source row in combined original files
variables.coding: Positive integer
variables.derivation: row_number() assigned before ARD selection; source-file and within-file record lookup exported separately

variables.description: Original machine-learning partition retained as provenance
variables.derivation: Assigned from the original input file; not re-randomised
variables.reference_or_contrast: First level train_2015_17; not a term in the illustrative model

variables.description: Calendar period of the source cohort
variables.derivation: Assigned from input cohort; no exact patient dates are introduced
variables.reference_or_contrast: Separate models are fitted by period

variables.description: Presence of existing diabetic retinopathy
variables.coding: 0 = absent; 1 = present
variables.derivation: Trim and uppercase source text; N -> 0, Y -> 1, anything else -> NA and outcome validation fails
variables.reference_or_contrast: 0 denotes absence; model response is integer 0/1

variables.description: Labelled representation of the DR outcome
variables.coding: No_DR; DR_Present
variables.derivation: Factor derived from dr_status with levels 0 and 1
variables.reference_or_contrast: No_DR is the first factor level

variables.description: Age brackets supplied in the public release
variables.derivation: Trim source text and preserve these ordered levels; unexpected values become NA and fail validation
variables.reference_or_contrast: Ordered factor; R default polynomial contrasts, not one reference age group

variables.description: Masked sex category; original category meanings are undisclosed
variables.coding: Code_0; Code_1; NA for missing source
variables.derivation: Preserve source code as a factor; no clinical or demographic relabelling

variables.description: Masked ethnicity category; original category meanings are undisclosed
variables.coding: Code_0; Code_1; NA for missing source
variables.derivation: Preserve source code as a factor; no clinical or demographic relabelling

variables.description: Duration of diabetes after project-specified screening
variables.coding: Numeric; NA may originate in the source or from the screening rule
variables.derivation: Keep source value when 0 <= value <= 85; otherwise NA. Bounds are analyst-specified assumptions, not validated physiological limits.

variables.description: HbA1c measurement after project-specified screening
variables.coding: Numeric; NA may originate in the source or from the screening rule
variables.derivation: Keep source value when 3 <= value <= 25; otherwise NA. Bounds are analyst-specified assumptions, not validated physiological limits.

variables.description: Operational HbA1c group; labels do not establish individual treatment targets
variables.coding: Controlled_lt7; Suboptimal_7_to_8.9; Uncontrolled_ge9
variables.derivation: <7%; >=7% and <9%; >=9%; NA when hba1c_clean is missing

variables.description: Blood urea nitrogen measurement after project-specified screening
variables.coding: Numeric; NA may originate in the source or from the screening rule
variables.derivation: Keep source value when 0 < value <= 250; otherwise NA. Bounds are analyst-specified assumptions, not validated physiological limits.
variables.reference_or_contrast: Used to derive BUN threshold flag

variables.description: Operational BUN threshold indicator; does not establish renal disease
variables.coding: FALSE; TRUE; NA
variables.derivation: TRUE for BUN >20 mg/dL, FALSE otherwise; NA for missing BUN

variables.description: Systolic blood-pressure measurement after project-specified screening
variables.coding: Numeric; NA may originate in the source or from the screening rule
variables.derivation: Keep source value when 50 <= value <= 300; otherwise NA. Bounds are analyst-specified assumptions, not validated physiological limits.
variables.reference_or_contrast: Used to derive BP threshold flag

variables.description: Diastolic blood-pressure measurement after project-specified screening
variables.coding: Numeric; NA may originate in the source or from the screening rule
variables.derivation: Keep source value when 30 <= value <= 200; additionally value < cleaned SBP when SBP is observed; otherwise NA. Bounds are analyst-specified assumptions, not validated physiological limits.
variables.reference_or_contrast: Used to derive BP threshold flag

variables.description: Operational BP threshold indicator; does not establish a hypertension diagnosis
variables.coding: FALSE; TRUE; NA
variables.derivation: NA if either pressure is missing; otherwise TRUE when SBP >=140 or DBP >=90 mmHg

variables.description: Haemoglobin measurement after project-specified screening
variables.coding: Numeric; NA may originate in the source or from the screening rule
variables.derivation: Keep source value when 3 <= value <= 25; otherwise NA. Bounds are analyst-specified assumptions, not validated physiological limits.

variables.description: Triglyceride measurement after project-specified screening
variables.coding: Numeric; NA may originate in the source or from the screening rule
variables.derivation: Keep source value when 0 < value <= 5000; otherwise NA. Bounds are analyst-specified assumptions, not validated physiological limits.

variables.description: Masked insulin-dependence category; original category meanings are undisclosed
variables.coding: Code_1; Code_2; NA for missing source
variables.derivation: Preserve source code as a factor; do not infer presence or absence from descriptive associations

variables.description: Masked nephropathy category; original category meanings are undisclosed
variables.coding: Code_1; Code_2; NA for missing source
variables.derivation: Preserve source code as a factor; do not infer presence or absence from descriptive associations

variables.description: Masked neuropathy category; original category meanings are undisclosed
variables.coding: Code_1; Code_2; NA for missing source
variables.derivation: Preserve source code as a factor; do not infer presence or absence from descriptive associations

variables.description: Masked stroke category; original category meanings are undisclosed
variables.coding: Code_1; Code_2; NA for missing source
variables.derivation: Preserve source code as a factor; do not infer presence or absence from descriptive associations

variables.description: HbA1c missing after cleaning; includes source missingness and newly censored values
variables.coding: FALSE = observed after cleaning; TRUE = missing after cleaning
variables.derivation: is.na(hba1c_clean); does not establish why a measurement is missing
variables.reference_or_contrast: Not a model term; not a correction for missing-data bias

variables.description: BUN missing after cleaning; includes source missingness and newly censored values
variables.coding: FALSE = observed after cleaning; TRUE = missing after cleaning
variables.derivation: is.na(bun_clean); does not establish why a measurement is missing
variables.reference_or_contrast: Not a model term; not a correction for missing-data bias

variables.description: One or both blood-pressure measurements missing after cleaning; includes source missingness and newly censored values
variables.coding: FALSE = observed after cleaning; TRUE = missing after cleaning
variables.derivation: is.na(sbp_clean) OR is.na(dbp_clean); does not establish why a measurement is missing
variables.reference_or_contrast: Not a model term; not a correction for missing-data bias

variables.description: Haemoglobin missing after cleaning; includes source missingness and newly censored values
variables.coding: FALSE = observed after cleaning; TRUE = missing after cleaning
variables.derivation: is.na(hemoglobin_clean); does not establish why a measurement is missing
variables.reference_or_contrast: Not a model term; not a correction for missing-data bias

variables.description: Triglycerides missing after cleaning; includes source missingness and newly censored values
variables.coding: FALSE = observed after cleaning; TRUE = missing after cleaning
variables.derivation: is.na(triglycerides_clean); does not establish why a measurement is missing
variables.reference_or_contrast: Not a model term; not a correction for missing-data bias

variables.description: Diabetes duration missing after cleaning; includes source missingness and newly censored values
variables.coding: FALSE = observed after cleaning; TRUE = missing after cleaning
variables.derivation: is.na(duration_yrs_clean); does not establish why a measurement is missing
variables.reference_or_contrast: Not a model term; not a correction for missing-data bias

variables.description: Number of missing grouped measurements after cleaning; not a count of individual laboratory tests
variables.coding: Integer from 0 to 6
variables.derivation: Sum six miss_* flags; BP contributes at most one, and diabetes duration is included
